title: Splitting of an essentially constant inverse system into its value and an essentially zero part (Stacks 070C, forward direction)
statement: Let $(C_i)_{i\ge1}$ be an inverse system of abelian groups [def-weil-inverse-system], with composite transition homomorphisms $t_{k,j}:C_k\to C_j$ for $k\ge j$ ($t_{j,j}=\mathrm{id}$, $t_{j,i}\circ t_{k,j}=t_{k,i}$). Suppose $(C_i)$ is essentially constant [def-weil-pbc-essentially-constant-system], with the data of that definition: an abelian group $X$, homomorphisms $\pi_i:X\to C_i$ with $t_{i+1,i}\circ\pi_{i+1}=\pi_i$ for all $i\ge1$, an index $i_0\ge1$ and a homomorphism $r:C_{i_0}\to X$ such that (a) $r\circ\pi_{i_0}=\mathrm{id}_X$ and (b) for every $j\ge1$ there is $k\ge\max(i_0,j)$ with $t_{k,j}=\pi_j\circ r\circ t_{k,i_0}$. For $j\ge i_0$ put $p_j=r\circ t_{j,i_0}:C_j\to X$ and $Z_j=\ker(p_j)\subseteq C_j$. Then: (1) $p_j\circ\pi_j=\mathrm{id}_X$ for every $j\ge i_0$; hence $\pi_j$ is injective and $C_j=\pi_j(X)\oplus Z_j$ (internal direct sum: every $c\in C_j$ is uniquely $c=\pi_j(x)+z$ with $x\in X$, $z\in Z_j$, namely $x=p_j(c)$); (2) for all $k\ge j\ge i_0$: $t_{k,j}\circ\pi_k=\pi_j$ and $p_j\circ t_{k,j}=p_k$; in particular $t_{k,j}(Z_k)\subseteq Z_j$, so that $(Z_j)_{j\ge i_0}$ with the restricted transition maps is an inverse system and $t_{k,j}$ respects the two decompositions; (3) for every $j\ge i_0$ there is $k\ge j$ such that $t_{k,j}(Z_k)=0$.

source.place: Homology, Lemma Tag 070C (lemma-essentially-constant, homology.tex line 7733), the implication 'essentially constant => decomposition A_j = A (+) Z_j for j >= i, compatible with the transition maps, with Z_{j'} -> Z_j zero for some j' >= j', and its proof lines 7746--7753 (Z_j = Ker(A_j -> A)). Stated here with the cone (X, pi_j) of the definition (Categories 05PU (2)) in place of the limit A = lim A_i and its projections, which the Stacks statement uses (the identification of the value with the limit is Categories 0G2V, not needed here); clause (1) is the splitting A_j = A (+) Z_j, clause (2) is (a), clause (3) is (b) of 070C. proof.text: Fix $j\ge i_0$. Compatibility of the cone maps gives $t_{j,i_0}\circ\pi_j=\pi_{i_0}$ (iterate the displayed compatibility with the adjacent transition maps). Therefore $p_j\circ\pi_j=r\circ t_{j,i_0}\circ\pi_j=r\circ\pi_{i_0}=\mathrm{id}_X$ by clause (a) of essential constancy. In particular, $\pi_j$ is injective.

source.place: Homology, proof of Lemma Tag 070C (lemma-essentially-constant), lines 7746--7753; the splitting implicit in 'setting Z_j = Ker(A_j -> A) works'

proof.text: For $c\in C_j$, put $x=p_j(c)$ and $z=c-\pi_j(x)$. Then $p_j(z)=p_j(c)-p_j\pi_jp_j(c)=0$, so $z\in Z_j$, and $c=\pi_j(x)+z$. If also $c=\pi_j(x')+z'$ with $z'\in Z_j$, applying $p_j$ gives $x'=p_j(c)=x$, and then cancellation gives $z'=z$. Thus $C_j=\pi_j(X)\oplus Z_j$ with the asserted formula.

source.place: Homology, proof of Lemma Tag 070C (lemma-essentially-constant), lines 7746--7753; the direct-sum calculation omitted after 'setting Z_j = Ker(A_j -> A) works'

proof.text: Let $k\ge j\ge i_0$. Cone compatibility gives $t_{k,j}\circ\pi_k=\pi_j$. Associativity of transition maps gives $p_j\circ t_{k,j}=r\circ t_{j,i_0}\circ t_{k,j}=r\circ t_{k,i_0}=p_k$. Hence $z\in Z_k$ implies $p_j(t_{k,j}z)=p_k(z)=0$, so $t_{k,j}$ restricts to a homomorphism $Z_k\to Z_j$. The identity on $\pi_k(X)$ and this restriction show that $t_{k,j}$ respects the direct-sum decompositions; associativity and identity for the restricted maps follow from those of the original inverse system.

source.place: Homology, Lemma Tag 070C (lemma-essentially-constant), clause (a), and proof lines 7746--7753

proof.text: Fix $j\ge i_0$. By clause (b) of essential constancy, choose $k\ge\max(i_0,j)=j$ such that $t_{k,j}=\pi_j\circ r\circ t_{k,i_0}=\pi_j\circ p_k$. If $z\in Z_k$, then $p_k(z)=0$, and therefore $t_{k,j}(z)=\pi_j(p_k(z))=0$. Thus the restricted transition map $Z_k\to Z_j$ is zero.

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against the forward implication of Stacks Homology 070C and the specialized definition of essential constancy in Categories 05PU (2)/05PV. The statement is correct and self-contained. Split the proof into four explicit steps: the retraction at every later index, the image-plus-kernel direct-sum calculation omitted by the source, compatibility of the complements with transition maps, and eventual vanishing from the defining factorization. No new node is needed; all non-elementary input is exactly the two existing definition dependencies. The recorded LeanSearch, LeanFinder, local and Mathlib-source searches show no Mathlib statement for the system-level result; LinearMap.isCompl_of_proj covers only the elementary one-index splitting.
